LanguageData.MUGB_TabSeedbedNoSurgeon: No male goblin is available to inject activator.
LanguageData.MUGB_SeedbedColumnAutoTip: Automatically queue a tumor activator injection as soon as this seedbed finishes a birth. Turning this off stops the line after the current cycle.
LanguageData.MUGB_TabSeedbedNoResearch: Fleshcraft research is not finished, so no seedbed surgery can be queued.
LanguageData.MUGB_SeedbedColumnConvertTip: Queue the tumor seedbed surgery for this pawn. This is permanent and cannot be undone once performed.
LanguageData.MUGB_SeedbedStageTip: Seedbed degeneration. Each birth advances one stage.
LanguageData.MUGB_SeedbedStageFinalTip: Final stage. She no longer grieves the births - the mood penalty is replaced by euphoria.
LanguageData.MUGB_MessageSeedbedExpired: {0} pushed out one last lump and stopped breathing. With nothing left to empty, her body found no reason to go on.
LanguageData.MUGB_SettingsSeedbedBirthLimitDesc: How many times a tumor seedbed gives birth before her body gives out. Counted in births, not tumors - one birth yields three to four tumors. The health tab shows her count beside the seedbed condition. Unlimited turns the lifespan off entirely.
